items.source: Interface representing the environment in which the current application is running.
items.translation: 表示当前应用程序运行环境的接口。

items.source: Interface indicating a component that contains and exposes an Environment reference.
items.translation: 指示包含并公开 `Environment` 引用的组件的接口。

items.source: Configuration interface to be implemented by most if not all Environment types.
items.translation: 大多数（如果不是全部）Environment 类型需要实现的配置接口。

items.source: Interface for resolving properties against any underlying source.
items.translation: 用于针对任何底层源解析属性的接口。

items.source: Configuration interface to be implemented by most if not all PropertyResolver types.
items.translation: 大多数（如果不是全部）PropertyResolver 类型需要实现的配置接口。

items.source: Abstract base class representing a source of name/value property pairs.
items.translation: 表示名称/值属性对来源的抽象基类。

items.source: A PropertySource implementation capable of interrogating its underlying source object to enumerate all possible property name/value pairs.
items.translation: 一个能够查询其底层源对象以枚举所有可能的属性名/值对的PropertySource实现。

items.source: PropertySource that reads keys and values from a Map object.
items.translation: PropertySource 用于从 Map 对象读取键和值。

items.source: The default implementation of the PropertySources interface.
items.translation: `PropertySources` 接口的默认实现。

items.source: Abstract base class for Environment implementations.
items.translation: Environment 实现的抽象基类。

items.source: This package contains mock implementations of the Environment and PropertySource abstractions.
items.translation: 该包包含 `Environment` 和 `PropertySource` 抽象的模拟实现。

items.source: PropertySource implementation that extracts properties from a Properties object.
items.translation: 提取属性自 `Properties` 对象的`PropertySource` 实现。

items.source: Holder containing one or more PropertySource objects.
items.translation: 包含一个或多个 `PropertySource` 对象的 Holder。

items.source: Profile predicate that may be accepted by an Environment.
items.translation: 可被接受的Environment配置属性谓词。

items.source: Abstract base class for PropertySource implementations backed by command line arguments.
items.translation: 由命令行参数支持的 `PropertySource` 实现的抽象基类。

items.source: Environment implementation suitable for use in 'standard' (i.e.
items.translation: Environment 实现，适用于“标准”（即

items.source: Classes supporting the org.springframework.beans.factory package.
items.translation: 支持org.springframework.beans.factory包的类。

items.source: Contains an abstract XML-based BeanFactory implementation, including a standard "spring-beans" XSD.
items.translation: 包含一个抽象的基于 XML 的 `BeanFactory` 实现，包括标准的"spring-beans"XSD。

items.source: Classes supporting the org.springframework.orm.jpa package.
items.translation: 支持org.springframework.orm.jpa包的类。

items.source: Support classes for the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: 支持Spring TestContext Framework的类。

items.source: Common utilities used within the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: Spring TestContext Framework 中使用的常用工具。

items.source: Classes supporting the org.springframework.web.context package, such as WebApplicationContext implementations and various utility classes.
items.translation: 支持org.springframework.web.context包的类，例如 WebApplicationContext 实现和各种实用工具类。

items.source: The core package implementing Spring's lightweight Inversion of Control (IoC) container.
items.translation: 实现 Spring 轻量级控制反转（IoC）容器的核心包。

items.source: Support package for Groovy-based bean definitions.
items.translation: 基于 Groovy 的 Bean 定义支持包。

items.source:
Classes supporting the org.springframework.beans package,
such as utility classes for sorting and holding lists of beans.
items.translation: 支持 org.springframework.beans 包的类，例如用于排序和持有 Bean 列表的工具类。

items.source:
This package builds on the beans package to add support for
message sources and for the Observer design pattern, and the
ability for application objects to obtain resources using a
consistent API.
items.translation: 该包在 beans 包的基础上增加了消息源和观察者设计模式的支持，并允许应用程序对象通过一致的 API 获取资源。

items.source:
Annotation support for the Application Context, including JSR-250 "common"
annotations, component-scanning, and Java-based metadata for creating
Spring-managed objects.
items.translation: 支持应用上下文的注解，包括 JSR-250“通用”注解、组件扫描以及用于创建 Spring 托管对象的基于 Java 的元数据。

items.source:
Classes supporting the org.springframework.context package,
such as abstract base classes for ApplicationContext
implementations and a MessageSource implementation.
items.translation: 支持 `org.springframework.context` 包的类，例如 `ApplicationContext` 实现的抽象基类和 `MessageSource` 实现。

items.source:
Spring's environment abstraction consisting of bean definition
profile and hierarchical property source support.
items.translation: Spring 的环境抽象由 Bean 定义配置文件和分层属性源支持组成。

items.source: Generic abstraction for (file-based) resources, used throughout the framework.
items.translation: 用于整个框架的（基于文件的）资源的通用抽象。

items.source: Support classes for Spring's resource abstraction.
items.translation: 支持 Spring 资源抽象的支持类。

items.source:
The classes in this package make JNDI easier to use,
facilitating the accessing of configuration stored in JNDI,
and provide useful superclasses for JNDI access classes.
items.translation: 该包中的类使 JNDI 更易使用，便于访问存储在 JNDI 中的配置，并为 JNDI 访问类提供有用的超类。

items.source:
Contains a variant of the application context interface for web applications,
and the ContextLoaderListener that bootstraps a root web application context.
items.translation: 包含用于 Web 应用程序的应用程序上下文接口的变体，以及引导根 Web 应用程序上下文的 ContextLoaderListener。

items.source: Provides generic filter base classes allowing for bean-style configuration.
items.translation: 提供通用过滤器基类，支持基于 Bean 的配置。

items.source: Support classes for the multipart resolution framework.
items.translation: 支持多部分解析框架的辅助类。

items.source:
Support for creating a registry of HTTP Service client proxies, and declaring
the proxies as beans.
items.translation: 支持创建 HTTP 服务客户端代理的注册表，并将这些代理声明为 Bean。

items.source:
Provides servlets that integrate with the application context
infrastructure, and the core interfaces and classes for the
Spring web MVC framework.
items.translation: 提供与应用程序上下文基础设施集成的 Servlet，以及 Spring Web MVC 框架的核心接口和类。

items.source: Support classes for serving static resources.
items.translation: 用于提供静态资源的辅助类。

items.source: Abstract base class for resolving properties against any underlying source.
items.translation: 用于针对任何底层源解析属性的抽象基类。

items.source: Exception thrown when required properties are not found.
items.translation: 当找不到必需属性时抛出异常。
